docs.title: Executive Summary
docs.text: This report presents a comprehensive threat analysis for AWS Connected Vehicle Solution - Vehicle Registration Feature.

docs.title: Project Information
docs.text:
• Application Name: AWS Connected Vehicle Solution - Vehicle Registration Feature
  • Architecture Type: Serverless microservices architecture with event-driven API-based interactions
  • Deployment Environment: AWS Cloud (single region deployment)
  • Industry Sector: Fleet Management / Automotive / IoT

docs.title: Technology Stack
docs.text:
• AWS Lambda
  • Amazon API Gateway
  • Amazon DynamoDB
  • Amazon S3
  • Amazon Cognito
  • AWS Amplify
  • REST API
  • PDF document storage
  • Pre-signed URLs
  • Server-side encryption
  • AWS CloudWatch
  • AWS WAF
  • AWS Shield
  • Amazon Macie
  • AWS Certificate Manager

docs.title: Security Objectives
docs.text:
• Protect vehicle registration data confidentiality
  • Ensure data integrity for vehicle registration records
  • Maintain availability of vehicle registration services
  • Implement strong authentication and authorization
  • Protect data in transit and at rest
  • Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive vehicle data
  • Ensure non-repudiation for billing purposes
  • Implement least privilege access controls
  • Monitor and detect security threats
  • Protect against DDoS attacks
  • Secure API endpoints
  • Prevent data leakage through logs
  • Implement input validation
  • Secure S3 pre-signed URLs

docs.title: Threat Analysis Results
docs.text:
• Total Threats: 11
  • High Severity: 6
  • Attack Trees Generated: 6

docs.title: High Severity Threats
docs.text:
1. 9b4dbea5-ccaa-41ea-a057-c6dd47f99523: An internal actor with access to the AWS account can deploy a lambda function that will use existing execution role, which leads to unauthorised access to sensitive data, resulting in reduced confidentiality of registration status
  1. 2df06a4e-b1eb-4303-bb48-46cf05182f58: An external threat actor with knowledge of employee email addresses can password spray Cognito, which leads to unauthorized access to Vehicle Registration System, resulting in reduced confidentiality of vehicle registration documents
  1. c5ac485c-a985-4004-be21-1fb26173a2d3: A threat actor with access to modify network traffic can manipulate API parameter input which leads to the API Gateway performing actions on another user's resources, resulting in reduced integrity and confidentiality of vehicle registration, vehicle listing, registration status, and vehicle registration documents.
  1. d38a0bd2-35cc-4c35-a48b-f73db6794a6e: A threat actor with access to an IAM Principal with modify access to the DynamoDB tables can delete the data, resulting in reduced availability of vehicle registration, vehicle listing, and registration status.
  1. 9c19d403-f595-45f8-ba66-df2e60744f67: A threat actor who is able to access the DynamoDB tables can access sensitive data, which leads to unauthorized access, resulting in reduced confidentiality of vehicle registration, vehicle listing and registration status
  1. e0e6089f-66d2-49ca-8be0-f9346ab85a14: A threat actor with possession of a similar domain name can trick our users into interacting with a fake endpoint, which leads to interception of valid API requests, negatively impacting vehicle registration, vehicle listing, registration status and vehicle registration documents
